description: This file defines the `AmazonInvokeNovaConfig` class, which extends configuration and request/response transformation logic for handling `nova` model invocations via Amazon Bedrock. It includes methods for transforming requests and responses, filtering allowed fields, and managing message data for interactions with the Bedrock API.
